newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures down in thin trade.

text.p: Rubber futures slipped by midday on Tuesday in thin, lacklustre trade with marginally lower prices in Japan weighing on local values, dealers said.

"There were probably some trades done, but the volume probably is very small. It's still a fairly quiet market and dealers just want to see if the situation will change this afternoon," a local rubber trader said.

Tokyo's benchmark April contract dipped 0.1 yen in the morning session to 141.4 yen while Kobe's April contract was unchanged in the morning at 141.0 yen before slipping 0.3 yen in the first afternoon session to reach 140.7.
At around 0445 GMT, December RSS3 was seen at 125.50 U.S. cents a kg compared with the previous settlement of 126.50 cents.
December RSS1 was indicated at 180.50 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg against 181.00 cents.
December TSR20 was indicated at 175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg from 176.25 cents.
